title: Wasserstein Exponential Smoothing for Distributional Time Series Forecasting
summary: Distributional time series arise when each temporal observation is a probability distribution rather than a scalar. We propose Wasserstein exponential smoothing (WES), a one-parameter recursive forecasting method for distributional time series on $\mathbb{R}$. The method adapts the practical logic of classical exponential smoothing to probability distributions by updating forecast distributions along Wasserstein geodesics.
